svg.title: One attention row, worked out by hand
svg.desc: A hand-drawn whiteboard showing the sentence 'the tired cat slept' with query, key and value strips hachured under each word, a four-by-four attention grid whose upper triangle is dashed red and crossed out as minus infinity before softmax, the bottom row filled in with 0.077, 0.082, 0.650 and 0.191 and the 0.650 highlighted, the exponentials and their sum of 13.03 left visible as rough work beside it, the scale factor root 128 equals 11.31 in its own panel, and three attention matrices drawn to the same scale where the 128k square dwarfs the nested 8k and 1k squares.
svg.text: One attention row, worked out by hand
slept looks at cat: 65% of its attention
all three squares drawn to the same scale
...and we redo this for every new token?
